title: Tardigrade Dsup: Interactions with DNA and protection of cells from oxidative stress.
authors: Ni, Gavin Shuyang; Su, Hetian; Zhu, Yingqi; Dhiman, Anshika; Zhou, Huan-Xiang; Lin, Wei; Hao, Nan
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学模拟与活细胞FRET成像研究缓步动物Dsup蛋白与DNA的互作及其氧化应激保护功能，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The remarkable capability of tardigrades to survive under extreme conditions has been partially attributed to Dsup, an intrinsically disordered, highly positively charged protein. Dsup has been shown to bind to DNA in vitro, a property that has been associated with the capability of Dsup to exhibit stress-protective effects when expressed in mammalian cells. However, DNA binding of Dsup has not been visualized in living cells, and expression of Dsup in different cell types was associated with either protective or detrimental effects. In addition, the effect of Dsup expression has not been clearly demonstrated at the organism level. Here, we combined molecular dynamics simulations and fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy with Forster resonance energy transfer to interrogate Dsup-DNA interactions and demonstrate Dsup binding to DNA in live mammalian cells. Furthermore, Dsup expression in both HEK293T cells and yeast enhanced cell survival in the presence of hydrogen peroxide, suggesting that the presence of Dsup allows both mammalian and yeast cells to better cope with oxidative stress. This study provides a better understanding of the property and functional role of Dsup and lays a foundation to explore new approaches to enhance stress resistance.
abstract_zh: 缓步动物在极端条件下生存的非凡能力部分归因于Dsup，这是一种本质无序、高度正电荷的蛋白质。已有研究表明，Dsup在体外能与DNA结合，这一特性与其在哺乳动物细胞中表达时展现的应激保护作用相关联。然而，Dsup在活细胞中的DNA结合尚未被可视化，且在不同细胞类型中表达Dsup与保护性或有害效应相关。此外，Dsup表达在生物体层面的效应尚未被明确证实。在此，我们结合分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和荧光寿命成像显微镜与福斯特共振能量转移 (Forster resonance energy transfer) 技术，探究Dsup-DNA相互作用，并证明Dsup在活体哺乳动物细胞中与DNA结合。进一步地，在HEK293T细胞和酵母中表达Dsup均增强了细胞在过氧化氢存在下的存活率，表明Dsup的存在使哺乳动物和酵母细胞能更好地应对氧化应激。本研究增进了对Dsup特性和功能角色的理解，并为探索增强应激抵抗力的新方法奠定了基础。
